summary_en: 3.0M shares (3.5% of shares outstanding ex-treasury), ¥2.0B ceiling, open-market acquisition 22Jul–30Sep2026. Concurrently, up to 4.0M shares (4.7% of S/O) to be cancelled on 30Sep2026, comprising all shares acquired plus 1.0M shares held in treasury.
